title: appendix-misc.md:58,66 diagram labels 'native /128' contradict settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision
description: Found during security pass of 3x codereview of b7z9.205. Appendix E topology diagram in spec/appendix-misc.md labels Border Router, Router A, Router B as 'native /128' (lines 58 and 66). The SHA-512 native address profile is rejected by the settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision (spec/decisions.jsonl): node /128s MUST equal upstream AddrForKey. Line 54 of the same file and the now-fixed appendix-design-rationale.md use Yggdrasil terminology; leaf /128 labels at line 73 carry no qualifier. Pre-existing (predates b7z9.205, blame 84b02e9757). Fix: relabel the three nodes to Yggdrasil /128 (or AddrForKey /128). Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.205.
close_reason: Relabeled the three Appendix E router nodes from rejected native /128 to Yggdrasil /128. Verified stale-label absence, expected labels, diagram alignment, and path-scoped diff check.
